title.narrative: Procurement and Infrastructure Support to Somalia Security Forces, Phase II

description.narrative: One of the biggest challenges faced by the Somalia Security Forces is the lack of infrastructure and non-lethal equipment such as vehicles and communication equipment, resulting in diminishing security personnel effectiveness in being able to train, organize and execute necessary military operations. Without adequate resourcing, the pursuit of the on-going shaping operations and their expansion to other parts of Somalia as well as the whole security transition from AMISOM to Somalia Security Forces is put at risk. \nThe European Union has engaged UNOPS as an implementing partner for a new set of African Peace Facility Capacity Building for Security and Development Actions aimed at supporting the Somalia Security Forces. UNOPS rehabilitates a Training Centre, which will go a long way in ensuring that there is a safe and well-equipped facility to be trained in. Additionally, this action will contribute to the provision of IT equipment for the operations, as well as transportation vehicles and essential personal equipment, such as basic hygienic kits, sports clothing, basic medical equipment and training materials, as well as a Physical Biometric Registration System.\n
